a_before_b.rationale: Atom A requires the learner to already understand when to finetune versus use RAG, so mastering A cannot precede the more foundational decision covered in Atom B.

b_before_a.rationale: Atom B establishes the criteria for choosing finetuning over prompt-based methods, which is necessary before a learner can meaningfully compare RAG against finetuning in Atom A.
